description: We are a team of five students — Dariya, Azhar, Ayora,Adina and Madina — united by our curiosity about space, science, technology, and innovation. We bring diverse skills in astronomy, mathematics, research, data analysis, design, communication, leadership, and entrepreneurship. For the  Abandoned but not Forgotten:Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars challenge, we aim to explore real astronomical data and turn our ideas into meaningful, practical solutions.
